sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 13 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：SPY、MU、MSFT、KOSPI、SNDK。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Trump Restarts Iran Blockade + 20% Hormuz "Toll": Intraday (around 11:00), Trump announced in a Fox interview and on Truth Social that the U.S. would become the "Guardian of the Hormuz Strait," "reimbursing" a 20% fee on all transit cargo and restarting the blockade against Iranian vessels. Brent rose about 4.7% to $79.6, and WTI rose about 4.8% to $74.7. As soon as the news hit, SPY saw an approximately 1-minute flash-crash long lower wick that was immediately bought back— the community unanimously identified it as an algorithmic script "Friday replay," and it was largely digested as noise.
  • South Korea's "Black Monday" Spillover: KOSPI closed down about 8.95%, triggering its seventh circuit breaker of the year; SK Hynix fell -15.4% in a single day, a record, wiping out nearly $200 billion in market value and bringing its closing market cap down to about $875 billion. The triggers were arbitrage-driven selling pressure after its Nasdaq ADR listing and KIS cutting its Q2 operating profit forecast to about 8% below consensus (HBM shipment concerns). This was the direct source of pressure on U.S. semiconductor stocks.
  • Semiconductors/Memory Hammered, Indexes Diverge: As of 11:48 ET, QQQ 715.9 (-1.34%) was dragged down by semiconductors, while SPY 751.6 (-0.44%) and DIA 524.6 (-0.22%) largely held up, with IWM 294.2 (-0.59%). MU 929.8 (-5%, briefly smashed to 903 intraday before rebounding to 943), SNDK 1713 (-10.6%), MRVL 221.6 (-6%), NVDA 207 (-1.9%), AMD 544 (-2.5%), TSM 429 (-1.3%).
  • Clear Defensive Rotation: MSFT 390.9 (+1.5%, jokingly called the "new VIX/inverse ETF," the most resilient), IBM 293 (+2%), RDDT 202.4 (+3.7%), and PLTR 130 (+2.7%) strengthened against the tape; AAPL 316.9 (+0.5%, surged to a new high of 323 early before pulling back).
  • Macro/Earnings-Heavy Week: CPI is scheduled for Tuesday (7/14) premarket, with headline inflation consensus around 3.8%; PPI on Wednesday. Major bank earnings on Tuesday include JPM, GS, WFC, C, BAC; Wednesday brings BLK/MS, ASML (before European market open), and TSM in focus, with NFLX on Thursday.

社区气氛：整体基调疲惫、麻木、混乱中立，以自嘲为主调——面对韩股熔断、油价飙升、封锁重启等一系列利空催化剂，SPY依然坚守752，每次下跌都瞬间V型回升。空头彻底崩溃，多头不敢追涨，社区从恐慌转向“这个市场就是不肯下跌”的黑色幽默和西塔折磨式的无力感。

恐惧/贪婪：表面恐慌信号强烈（KOSPI熔断、油价、10年期收益率4.6%），但VIX“梦游”，SPY距ATH不到1%，实际情绪倾向于“麻木的贪婪”。业界屡屡惊叹“所有看跌催化剂都在这里，指数就是不跌”。

情绪与现实：WSB 情绪与实际价格走势严重背离——评论区一片红海，到处都是哀嚎声，但大盘仅下跌 0.4%。几位资深人士指出，“指数价格维持着健康的表象，而在表面之下（内存、空间、软件、防御之外的一切）却存在着巨大的危险。”
